children: Iraq's SOMO is looking to buy 2500-ppm sulphur gasoil for September-December delivery, showed a document reviewed by Reuters, its second such procurement tender this year.

The state-owned firm is seeking around 446,250 metric tons of the industrial and transport fuel for delivery to Khor Al Zubair port, with the laycan of the first 40,000-ton cargo on or before September 15, the document showed.
The tender closes on September 7, with a 20-day validity period for offers.
SOMO did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside of office hours.
In July, SOMO sought gasoil for August-September delivery, with trading sources attributing the import demand to a lack of cargo from other suppliers.
Iraq started up its new Karbala refinery in 2023 and had offered term sale cargo early this year.
